articles.title: Claude AI Exploits Linux Kernel Flaw to Execute Root Commands Without User Interaction
articles.summary:
Anthropic says an unreleased Claude research model wrote a working exploit for a critical Linux kernel bug, tracked as CVE-2026-98432. The exploit lets a remote attacker run commands as root with no login and no user action. Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team shared the finding on October 27, 2026, and the flaw is already patched upstream. […]

The post Claude AI Exploits Linux Kernel Flaw to Execute Root Commands Without User Interaction appeared first on Cyber Security News.

articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Cisco SD-WAN 0-Day Flaw to Deploy KeyDrift Malware and Steal Encryption Keys
articles.summary:

articles.title: Chinese Hackers Use Secret Silent Train Network to Exploit Zero-Days Against U.S. Government and Defense
articles.summary:
China-linked Volt Typhoon hackers have used a covert network called Silent Train to hide zero-day attacks against U.S. government agencies, defense contractors and critical infrastructure. The network chains together compromised routers, connected devices and enterprise servers, helping operators reach sensitive systems while concealing where their activity begins. articles.title: Hackers Claim Wagyu Crypto Platform Breach as Researchers Find Thousands of Monero Transaction Records
articles.summary:
Hackers have claimed a breach of cryptocurrency swap platform Wagyu.xyz, while researchers reviewing the purported leak found thousands of records connecting Monero transactions with public blockchain payments and IP addresses. The dataset contains 38,628 order records and 10,139 distinct IP addresses, covering activity between July 18 and October 26, 2026. Its origin and authenticity remain […]

articles.title: Hackers Attack FreePBX Servers With Malware to Steal SIP Credentials for Phone Fraud
articles.summary:

The INJ3CTOR3 operation now collects configuration files containing SIP trunk passwords, database credentials, management secrets, and mail relay logins, extending the damage beyond the compromised server.
